subject: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hamilton@acme.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff

Hi team,

Attached is the initial OKR draft for Q3 (okr-draft-v1.xlsx). This captures the product & platform objectives we discussed last week and an initial estimate of engineering resource needs (high level). Key asks:

- Please review the objectives and identify anything that is out of scope for Q3 by EOD Monday (June 21).
- Confirm any absolute "must have" items that cannot be deprioritized.
- Laura, can you flag any customer commitments that should be treated as non-negotiable?

High-level highlights:
- Objective A: Reduce average 95th percentile latency by 20% for hosted API (requires sustained 2 FTEs on runtime optimizations).
- Objective B: Launch dedicated autoscaling policies + monitoring for Reserved capacity (1.5 FTE backend, 0.5 FTE for infra).
- Objective C: Expand model catalog to include two verified quantized variants for our top-tier models (1 FTE for model infra + 0.5 FTE for verification).

I included a short resource plan in the spreadsheet. If we can't commit the requested FTEs, we should reduce one of the objectives or push parts to Q4. I want to get leadership alignment this week so we can publish the QBR packet with clear asks.

I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call early next week — please indicate availability in the calendar invite when it lands.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachment: okr-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - OKR targets + rough resource estimates)

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hamilton@acme.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff

Thanks for the draft, Aditya. Quick reads and initial reactions below.

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 10:02 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is the initial OKR draft for Q3 (okr-draft-v1.xlsx).

Top-line: we need to be careful about asking for ~4 FTEs of runtime work in the same sprint window given current hires and two active customer migrations. A couple of requests:

- Can we split Objective A into "latency wins" (short-term kernel tuning) vs "arch changes" (longer runway)? If so, move the arch changes to Q4.
- For Objective B, the monitoring/observability work is critical for renewals with Acme — mark that as high priority.
- Add a one-paragraph risk section in the packet about hiring vs contractor assumptions.

I've attached a quick resource note: resource-plan.pdf with proposed phasing. If we accept the phasing, I think we can commit to the measurable parts for the QBR.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: resource-plan.pdf (PDF - proposed phasing and risks)

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hamilton@acme.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff

Laura — thanks, this is helpful. I updated the OKR doc and created okr-draft-v2.xlsx attached. Changes I made:

- Objective A split into A1 (kernel & config tuning — Q3) and A2 (architectural cache changes — moved to Q4).
- Objective B: left core autoscaling work in Q3, moved some dashboard items to "Q3 stretch". Marked monitoring for Acme as a high-priority deliverable.
- Added a "risks & assumptions" paragraph as you suggested (hiring vs contractor).

Action items:
- Grace: can you confirm platform readiness for the autoscaling changes? Any infra pre-reqs?
- Karthik: want your quick take on whether these objectives create any conflicts with Dedicated capacity roadmap.
- Laura: if resource-plan.pdf looks good, can you sign off on the customer commitments section so I can finalize the QBR packet?

I booked a 30-min alignment slot for Tue Jun 22 10:00–10:30 PT — calendar invite should be visible.

Aditya

Attachment: okr-draft-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet - updated targets and risk paragraph)

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hamilton@acme.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> I booked a 30-min alignment slot for Tue Jun 22 10:00–10:30 PT — calendar invite should be visible.

Quick update from platform: the autoscaling changes are feasible in Q3 but we have two infra pre-reqs that add short workstreams:

1) KV-cache eviction instrumentation (estimated 1.5 engineer-weeks).
2) Canary routing controls in the control plane (2 engineer-weeks).

Both items can be completed alongside the kernel tuning but will tighten our schedule. My recommendation: accept Laura's phasing, prioritize the Acme monitoring deliverable, and treat the canary controls as a hard dependency for the Dedicated autoscaling rollout.

I'll bring a short slide to the alignment call showing the pre-reqs and the minimal timeline.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Platform Reliability
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: sara.hamilton@acme.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OKR scope and resource commitment — Q3 kickoff

Thanks everyone — I've reviewed okr-draft-v2 and Grace's pre-req notes.

Decision / Sign-off: APPROVED with the following clarifications:

- Engineering capacity: we will reassign one backend engineer from the infra backlog to the autoscaling work for the first two sprints; this meets the 2 FTE short-term ask.
- Dedicated roadmap: canary routing controls will be added to the Dedicated milestone list; delivery target confirmed as end of Q3 (subject to no major incidents).
- Customer commitments: Laura's resource-plan.pdf is accepted for the QBR packet; please include the "risks & assumptions" paragraph and the hiring timeline slide.

Aditya — you have formal leadership approval to finalize the QBR packet and send to Acme for their review.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Engineering
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 10:05 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update from platform: the autoscaling changes are feasible in Q3 but we have two infra pre-reqs...

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com

Sara — thanks for the early partner visibility. Let us know if Acme wants any adjustments in the monitoring scope; Laura will follow up with a short note in the QBR packet.
